title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-26
lineage: Master Reel (Teac A-6100) -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Fostex FR-2LE -> WAV (24bit/96k)  Mastering Info: WAV (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with a few speed/pitch quirks but overall good clarity; the show shines with a smoking Dark Star, Hard to Handle and Duane Allman's lead on Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The Miller SBD tape captures a complete Fillmore East performance that, despite occasional channel swaps and slight pitch wobble, remains listenable. Musically the night is highlighted by a powerful Dark Star, an inspired Hard to Handle and memorable guest work from Duane Allman on Sugar Magnolia, though some sections (e.g., Casey Jones) suffer from poorer sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (4‑5 stars) and praise key performances; recording issues are noted but not enough to outweigh the musical strengths.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear SBD, but reports of speed/pitch wavering, channel swaps on some tracks, and occasional muddy sections (e.g., Casey Jones).

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set features repeat material with solid performances; second set benefits from Duane Allman's guest spots and a strong Dark Star, though some songs are noted as out‑of‑tune.
